```{r setup, include=FALSE}
get_results <- function(tbl_name) {
  if (data_source == 'local') {
    rslt <- read_csv(paste0('../results/', tbl_name, '.csv'))
  }
  else {
    rslt <- results_tbl(tbl_name) %>% collect()
  }
rslt
}

prettify_kable <- function(data) {
  rslt <- data %>% kable(digits = 2, format.args = list(big.mark = ','))
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) rslt <- rslt %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = F, border_right = T)
  rslt
}

prettify_kable2 <- function(data) {
  rslt <- data %>% kable(digits = 2, format.args = list(big.mark = ','))
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) rslt <- rslt %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
      scroll_box(width = "800px", height = "600px")
  rslt
}

prettify_kable3 <- function(data) {
  rslt <- data %>% kable(digits = 4, format.args = list(big.mark = ','))
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) rslt <- rslt %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = F, border_right = T)
  rslt
}
```

# Confidentiality

**Please treat the contents of this report as confidential, and do not
redistribute beyond PEDSnet staff and the requester.**

# Notes and Data Source
* **Investigator:** Greg Tasian
* **Institution:** CHOP
* **Title:** Building Recovery from Discharge to Growth and Engagement (BRIDGE) Trial
* **Data Source:** pedsnet_dcc_v62 (2026-07)
* The index diagnosis date was defined as the earliest inpatient stay meeting the study cohort criteria.
* Index diagnosis types were categorized based on a hierarchy, when multiple diagnosis types existed. From highest to lowest priority:
  * Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia
  * Esophageal Atresia
  * Anorectal Malformation
  * Hirschsprung Disease
  * Gastroschisis
* Outcomes:
  * Unplanned hospitalizations were defined as hospitalizations preceded by an Emergency Department visit.
  * Planned hospitalizations were defined as hospitalizations without a preceding Emergency Department visit.
  * ICU stays were defined as visits to the PICU, NICU, or CICU.
  * Outcomes were examined up to 180 days and 365 days after the index diagnosis **discharge date.**
    * For patients with index dates in 2025: We were only able to examine outcomes occurring up to 365 days later as of **5/31/2025**; we could only examine outcomes occurring up to 180 days later as of **12/2/2025**. (The 2026-07 database only covers dates through 5/31/2026.)

# Patient Attrition

* In-person visits include any outpatient, inpatient, or ED physician visits
  * Inpatient hospital stay (9201); Inpatient Hospital Stay - Ongoing (2000001532); ED Admit to Inpatient Stay (2000000048); Observation Stay (2000000088); ED (9203); Ambulatory/Outpatient Physician Visit (9202); Telemedicine (581399); Non-Acute Institutional Stay (44814710); Long Term Care Visit (42898160)


## Cohort Demographics by Year of Index Diagnosis Date
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, paged.print=FALSE}
var_label(cohort) <- list(
  site = 'Health System',
  year = 'Year of Index Inpatient Diagnosis',
  sex_cat = 'Sex',
  raceeth_cat = 'Race/Ethnicity',
  age_group = 'Age Group at Index Inpatient Diagnosis',
  two_plus_conds_within_dx_type = 'Has ≥2 condition records within a diagnosis type',
  three_plus_conds_within_dx_type = 'Has ≥3 condition records within a diagnosis type',
  index_dx_type_hierarchy = 'Index inpatient diagnosis type',
  any_unplanned_hosp_180 = 'Has ≥1 unplanned hospitalizations within 180 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  any_unplanned_hosp_365 = 'Has ≥1 unplanned hospitalizations within 365 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  any_planned_hosp_180 = 'Has ≥1 planned hospitalizations within 180 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  any_planned_hosp_365 = 'Has ≥1 planned hospitalizations within 365 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  any_icu_180 = 'Has ≥1 ICU visits within 180 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  any_icu_365 = 'Has ≥1 ICU visits within 365 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  age = 'Age at Index Inpatient Diagnosis (Years)',
  
  unplanned_visit_days_180 = 'Total unplanned hospitalization days within 180 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  unplanned_visit_days_365 = 'Total unplanned hospitalization days within 365 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  n_unique_unplanned_hosps_180 = 'Total planned hospitalizations within 180 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  n_unique_unplanned_hosps_365 = 'Total planned hospitalizations within 365 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  
  planned_visit_days_180 = 'Total planned hospitalization days within 180 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  planned_visit_days_365 = 'Total planned hospitalization days within 365 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  n_unique_planned_hosps_180 = 'Total planned hospitalizations within 180 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  n_unique_planned_hosps_365 = 'Total planned hospitalizations within 365 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
                          
  icu_visit_days_180 = 'Total days in the ICU within 180 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  icu_visit_days_365 = 'Total days in the ICU within 365 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  n_unique_icu_stays_180 = 'Total ICU stays within 180 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge',
  n_unique_icu_stays_365 = 'Total ICU stays within 365 days after inpatient diagnosis discharge'
)

cohort_demog_by_year <- cohort %>%
  tbl_summary(by = year,
              include = c(site,
                          year,
                          sex_cat,
                          raceeth_cat,
                          age_group,
                          
                          # anorectal_malformation,
                          # esophageal_atresia,
                          # gastroschisis,
                          # congenital_diaphragmatic_hernia,
                          # hirschsprung_disease,
                          # index_dx_type,
                          index_dx_type_hierarchy,
                          two_plus_conds_within_dx_type,
                          three_plus_conds_within_dx_type,

                          any_unplanned_hosp_180,
                          any_unplanned_hosp_365,
                          
                          any_planned_hosp_180,
                          any_planned_hosp_365,
                          
                          any_icu_180,
                          any_icu_365
                          )
              ) %>%
    modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>%
      mutate(
        stat_1 = gsub("^([0-4]) .*$", "<5", stat_1),
        stat_2 = gsub("^([0-4]) .*$", "<5", stat_2),
        stat_3 = gsub("^([0-4]) .*$", "<5", stat_3),
        stat_4 = gsub("^([0-4]) .*$", "<5", stat_4),
        stat_5 = gsub("^([0-4]) .*$", "<5", stat_5),
        stat_6 = gsub("^([0-4]) .*$", "<5", stat_6)
      )
  )

cohort_demog_by_year
```
